function createCustomPersonaId(){return'cp_'+Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9);}
function prepareCustomPersona(data,keepId){data=data&&typeof data==='object'?data:{};var out=customPersonaDefaults();for(var i=0;i<CUSTOM_PERSONA_FIELDS.length;i++){var key=CUSTOM_PERSONA_FIELDS[i].key;if(data[key]!=null)out[key]=customPersonaValue(data[key]).trim();}if(!out.systemName&&data.name)out.systemName=String(data.name).trim();out.version=2;var rawId=keepId&&data.id?String(data.id).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g,''):'';out.id=rawId||createCustomPersonaId();out.conditionalMechanisms=sanitizeCustomConditionalMechanisms(data.conditionalMechanisms,out.id);normalizeCustomPersonaCorpus(out);return out;}
function writeCustomPersonaLibrary(list){var clean=[],seen={};for(var i=0;i<(Array.isArray(list)?list.length:0);i++){var item=list[i];if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||!String(item.systemName||item.name||'').trim())continue;var prepared=prepareCustomPersona(item,true);if(seen[prepared.id])prepared.id=createCustomPersonaId();seen[prepared.id]=true;clean.push(prepared);}if(clean.length===0){delSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_LIBRARY_KEY);return true;}return setSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_LIBRARY_KEY,JSON.stringify(clean));}
function readCustomPersonaLibrary(){var raw=getSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_LIBRARY_KEY),parsed=[];if(Array.isArray(raw))parsed=raw;else if(raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&Array.isArray(raw.personas))parsed=raw.personas;else if(typeof raw==='string'&&raw.trim()){try{var value=JSON.parse(raw);parsed=Array.isArray(value)?value:(value&&Array.isArray(value.personas)?value.personas:[]);}catch(e){parsed=[];}}var list=[],ids={};for(var i=0;i<parsed.length;i++){var item=parsed[i];if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||!String(item.systemName||item.name||'').trim())continue;var prepared=prepareCustomPersona(item,true);if(ids[prepared.id])prepared.id=createCustomPersonaId();ids[prepared.id]=true;list.push(prepared);}var active=readCustomPersona();if(active&&String(active.systemName||active.name||'').trim()){var activeId=String(getSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_ACTIVE_ID_KEY)||active.id||'');var found=-1;for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++){if((activeId&&list[j].id===activeId)||list[j].systemName===String(active.systemName||active.name).trim()){found=j;break;}}if(found<0){var migrated=prepareCustomPersona(Object.assign({},active,{id:activeId}),true);list.push(migrated);found=list.length-1;}if(!active.id||active.id!==list[found].id){active=Object.assign({},active,{id:list[found].id});setSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_KEY,JSON.stringify(active));}setSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_ACTIVE_ID_KEY,list[found].id);}if(list.length>0)writeCustomPersonaLibrary(list);return list;}
function findCustomPersonaById(id,list){list=list||readCustomPersonaLibrary();for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++)if(list[i].id===id)return list[i];return null;}
function customPersonaNameConflict(name,exceptId){var list=readCustomPersonaLibrary(),target=String(name||'').trim();for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++)if(list[i].systemName===target&&list[i].id!==exceptId)return list[i];return null;}
function saveCustomPersonaToLibrary(data,matchName){var list=readCustomPersonaLibrary();var prepared=prepareCustomPersona(data,true);var index=-1;for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){if(list[i].id===prepared.id||(matchName&&list[i].systemName===prepared.systemName)){index=i;break;}}if(index>=0){prepared.id=list[index].id;list[index]=prepared;}else list.push(prepared);if(!writeCustomPersonaLibrary(list))return null;resetCustomPersonaConditionState(prepared.id);return prepared;}
function refreshCustomPersonaMenus(){var docs=[document];try{if(window.parent&&window.parent.document!==document)docs.push(window.parent.document);}catch(e){}for(var i=0;i<docs.length;i++){var doc=docs[i];var local=doc.getElementById('persona-mgr-inline');if(local)local.innerHTML=buildPersonaListHTML();var floats=doc.querySelectorAll('[data-persona-container]');for(var j=0;j<floats.length;j++)floats[j].innerHTML=buildPersonaListHTML();var dec=doc.getElementById('persona-decouple-inline');if(dec)dec.innerHTML=renderPersonaDecoupleHTML();var fdec=doc.querySelectorAll('[data-subpersona-container]');for(var k=0;k<fdec.length;k++)fdec[k].innerHTML=renderPersonaDecoupleHTML();}}
function activateCustomPersona(persona,toastFn){if(!persona||!persona.id)return false;var prepared=prepareCustomPersona(persona,true);if(!setSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_KEY,JSON.stringify(prepared)))return false;setSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_ACTIVE_ID_KEY,prepared.id);setPersona('custom',toastFn||showToast);refreshCustomPersonaMenus();return true;}
function removeCustomPersonaFromLibrary(id,toastFn){var list=readCustomPersonaLibrary(),next=[];for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++)if(list[i].id!==id)next.push(list[i]);if(next.length===list.length)return false;writeCustomPersonaLibrary(next);var activeId=String(getSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_ACTIVE_ID_KEY)||'');if(activeId===id){delSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_KEY);delSTVariable(CUSTOM_PERSONA_ACTIVE_ID_KEY);if(getCurrentPersona()==='custom')setPersona('reader',toastFn||showToast);}resetCustomPersonaConditionState(id);refreshCustomPersonaMenus();return true;}
function parseCustomPersonaImport(payload){var items=Array.isArray(payload)?payload:(payload&&Array.isArray(payload.personas)?payload.personas:[payload]);var prepared=[];for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){if(!items[i]||typeof items[i]!=='object'||Array.isArray(items[i]))throw new Error('第'+(i+1)+'项不是人格对象');var item=prepareCustomPersona(items[i],true);var missing=validateCustomPersona(item);if(missing.length)throw new Error('“'+(item.systemName||'第'+(i+1)+'项')+'”缺少：'+missing.map(customPersonaFieldLabel).join('、'));prepared.push(item);}if(prepared.length===0)throw new Error('JSON中没有人格');return prepared;}
function mergeImportedCustomPersonas(items){var list=readCustomPersonaLibrary(),count=0;for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){var item=items[i],index=-1;for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++){if(list[j].id===item.id||list[j].systemName===item.systemName){index=j;break;}}if(index>=0){item.id=list[index].id;list[index]=item;}else list.push(item);count++;}if(!writeCustomPersonaLibrary(list))throw new Error('人格库写入失败');for(var k=0;k<items.length;k++)resetCustomPersonaConditionState(items[k].id);return count;}

async function getPrimaryWorldbookName(){var TH=ensureTavernApi();if(typeof TH.getCharWorldbookNames==='function'){var info=await TH.getCharWorldbookNames('current');if(info&&info.primary){var allBooks=[info.primary].concat(Array.isArray(info.additional)?info.additional:[]).filter(Boolean);return {primary:info.primary,allBooks:allBooks};}}throw new Error('未找到主世界书');}
async function ensureYuanPlusWorldbook(){var TH=ensureTavernApi();if(typeof TH.getCharWorldbookNames!=='function')throw new Error('未检测到角色卡世界书接口');var info=await TH.getCharWorldbookNames('current');var primary=info&&info.primary?info.primary:null;var additional=info&&Array.isArray(info.additional)?info.additional.slice():[];if(primary===YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME||additional.indexOf(YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME)!==-1)return {bookName:YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME};if(typeof TH.getWorldbookNames==='function'){var names=await TH.getWorldbookNames();if(!Array.isArray(names)||names.indexOf(YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME)===-1){if(typeof TH.createWorldbook!=='function')throw new Error('未检测到世界书创建接口');await TH.createWorldbook(YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME);}}else if(typeof TH.createWorldbook!=='function'){throw new Error('未检测到世界书创建接口');}else{await TH.createWorldbook(YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME);}additional.push(YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME);if(typeof TH.rebindCharWorldbooks==='function'){await TH.rebindCharWorldbooks('current',{primary:primary,additional:additional});}else if(typeof TH.setCurrentCharLorebooks==='function'){await TH.setCurrentCharLorebooks({additional:additional});}else{throw new Error('未检测到角色卡绑定世界书接口');}return {bookName:YUAN_PLUS_BOOK_NAME};}

function isYuanPlusBlueWhitelist(entry){var name=entry&&entry.name?String(entry.name):'';for(var i=0;i<YUAN_PLUS_BLUE_WHITELIST.length;i++){if(name.indexOf(YUAN_PLUS_BLUE_WHITELIST[i])!==-1)return true;}return false;}
function matchYuanPlusGreenEntry(entry, preference){if(!entry||!entry.enabled||!preference)return false;var strategy=entry.strategy||{};if(strategy.type!=='selective')return false;var keys=Array.isArray(strategy.keys)?strategy.keys:[];for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){var key=keys[i];if(typeof key==='string'&&key&&preference.indexOf(key)!==-1)return true;}return false;}
async function collectYuanPlusKnowledge(allBooks, preference){var TH=ensureTavernApi();if(typeof TH.getWorldbook!=='function')throw new Error('未检测到世界书读取接口');var blue=[];var green=[];var names={};for(var b=0;b<allBooks.length;b++){try{var entries=await TH.getWorldbook(allBooks[b]);for(var i=0;i<entries.length;i++){var entry=entries[i];if(!entry||!entry.enabled||!entry.name||isYuanPlusTemplateEntry(entry))continue;var name=String(entry.name);if(names[name])continue;var sType=entry.strategy?entry.strategy.type:'NO_STRATEGY';if(sType==='constant'){if(isYuanPlusBlueWhitelist(entry)){blue.push('【'+name+'】\n'+(entry.content||''));names[name]=1;}continue;}if(sType==='selective'&&preference){var skeys=entry.strategy.keys||[];if(!Array.isArray(skeys))skeys=[];var hit=false;for(var k=0;k<skeys.length;k++){var sk=skeys[k];if(typeof sk==='string'&&sk&&preference.indexOf(sk)!==-1){hit=true;break;}if(sk&&typeof sk.test==='function'&&sk.test(preference)){hit=true;break;}}if(hit){green.push('【'+name+'】\n'+(entry.content||''));names[name]=1;}}}}catch(e){}}console.log('[YuanPlus] Collected blue:', blue.length, 'green:', green.length);return {blue:blue,green:green};}
function buildYuanPlusPrompt(templateText, preference, knowledge){var parts=[templateText.trim()];if(preference)parts.push('【用户偏好】\n'+preference);if(knowledge.blue&&knowledge.blue.length)parts.push('【白名单蓝灯条目】\n'+knowledge.blue.join('\n\n'));if(knowledge.green&&knowledge.green.length)parts.push('【由用户偏好触发的绿灯条目】\n'+knowledge.green.join('\n\n'));parts.push('严格按照上面的模板输出。');return parts.join('\n\n');}

function buildYuanPlusEntry(name, content, kwResult){var shortName=buildYuanPlusShortName(name);var primaryKeys=kwResult&&kwResult.primary?kwResult.primary:[];var secondaryKeys=kwResult&&kwResult.secondary?kwResult.secondary:[];var keys=uniqueList([name,shortName].concat(primaryKeys));return {name:name,enabled:true,strategy:{type:'selective',keys:keys,keys_secondary:secondaryKeys.length>0?{logic:'and_any',keys:secondaryKeys}:{logic:'and_any',keys:[]},scan_depth:'same_as_global'},position:{type:'after_character_definition',role:'system',depth:0,order:601},content:content,probability:100,recursion:{prevent_incoming:true,prevent_outgoing:true,delay_until:null},effect:{sticky:null,cooldown:null,delay:null}};}
